newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to tell G7 forex stability important -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan to tell G7 forex stability important -- MOF.

text.p: Japan will tell Group of Seven finance ministers this weekend that stability in the foreign exchange market is important and that there is a need to take appropriate action against excessive currency movements, Japan's Vice Finance Minister Tadashi Ogawa told a news conference on Monday.

"We will attend the meeting with the basic stance that currency stability is very important and that there is a need to act appropriately against excessive moves in foreign exchange markets," Ogawa said.
Finance ministers and central bankers from the Group of Seven nations are scheduled to meet on Saturday in Berlin.
Ogawa also said Japan would tell its G7 partners that its economy is becoming steadier and exchange views on its planned reforms, including fiscal and financial reforms.
